method: Each wheel GLB is mounted on every full R4 port of the 30 R4 blocks (PR #963): socket 30 mm off the port centre along the port normal, 4 rolls; contact = 13x13 rays in the gap, both faces flush (PASS >= 70% flush, recesses allowed, nothing protruding or missing); overlap = BVH of all wheel meshes at 10 sampled frames vs the whole block.
